items.title: #499 — The Birth of AGI
items.description: Sam Harris speaks with Kevin Roose about the race to build artificial general intelligence. They discuss Roose's book The AGI Chronicles, the scaling laws behind AI's rapid progress, Dario Amodei's "big blob of compute" memo, the birth of reasoning models, Roose's encounter with Bing's Sydney chatbot, the roughly 50 people deciding humanity's future, the rivalries among lab leaders, AI agents and recursive self-improvement, the absence of regulation, and other topics. items.show: Blocks: I Wish I Knew w/ Neal Brennan
items.title: Bobby Lee: I Wish I Knew
items.description: Bobby Lee joins Neal Brennan to share what he wishes he knew sooner: worrying about his career wouldn’t change its course, asking for help mattered, and the life he built could look different from the one he imagined. He still likes the MadTV tattoo, though. They talk about Bobby’s first stand-up special, learning to watch himself on screen, sobriety, his father’s death, and the unexpected emotional impact of a trip to Build-A-Bear. Plus: homemade glue hands, a swimming pool full of coffee, Neal’s place in the comedy police, and whether he’s allowed to speak at Bobby’s funeral. ---------------
items.reason: Bobby Lee with Neal Brennan on Blocks: your favorite pairing, and a candid talk on sobriety, his father's death, and career.

items.title: Paul Christiano – We could be 12 months away from AIs that can overthrow the government

items.title: Moxie Marlinspike on Cryptography, Privacy, and Mass Surveillance
items.description: Help us keep the conversations going in 2027. Donate to Conversations with Tyler today . Moxie Marlinspike built Signal and designed the encryption protocol underneath it — the same protocol that also secures WhatsApp, Facebook Messenger, and Skype. He's spent his career on the unglamorous, structural side of privacy, down to whether the company itself can see your contacts, your group names, or your search history. That background makes him an unusually direct interlocutor on the biggest live question in his field: whether the recent flood of AI-assisted math results could put cryptography it
items.reason: Moxie Marlinspike on Signal, encryption and surveillance, interviewed by Tyler Cowen: exactly the deep-expert format you star.

items.title: Why Anthropic’s IPO Didn’t Stop the Tech Selloff
items.description: Anthropic made its much-anticipated debut on the stock market yesterday. But as WSJ’s Peter Rudegeair explains, investors are worried about pressures on other stocks in the AI and tech sectors, leading to a huge sell off that’s raining on the Anthropic parade.
